label: Copy runs the old code wrote during the deploy into runs

execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."runs" ("id", "persona_id", "source", "title", "link_id", "schedule_id", "scheduled_for", "webhook_id", "status", "session_id", "result", "created_at", "claimed_at", "ended_at") SELECT r."id", s."persona_id", 'automation', s."name", s."link_id", r."schedule_id", r."scheduled_for", NULL, r."status", r."session_id", r."result", r."created_at", r."claimed_at", r."ended_at" FROM "public"."schedule_runs" r JOIN "public"."schedules" s ON s."id" = r."schedule_id" ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "public"."runs" ("id", "persona_id", "source", "title", "link_id", "schedule_id", "scheduled_for", "webhook_id", "status", "session_id", "result", "created_at", "claimed_at", "ended_at") SELECT r."id", w."persona_id", 'webhook', w."name", w."link_id", NULL, NULL, r."webhook_id", r."status", r."session_id", r."result", r."created_at", r."created_at", r."ended_at" FROM "public"."webhook_runs" r JOIN "public"."webhooks" w ON w."id" = r."webhook_id" ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

postcheck.description: every old run is in runs
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."schedule_runs" o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."runs" n WHERE n."id" = o."id")) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."webhook_runs" o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."runs" n WHERE n."id" = o."id")) AS "result"
